result.summary: Several layout and content overflow issues: restaurant names and category chips are clipped, the last promo card is cut off, and a few UI elements (empty profile badge, unlabeled heart buttons) look unfinished.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is clipped on the right, cutting off the name and image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousels have consistent card widths, padding, and peek so names and images are fully visible or clearly indicate more content.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo card is cut off by the tab bar, so most of the restaurant details are missing.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The cuisine filter chips row is clipped on the right (Healthy is cut off, next chip barely visible).
issues.suggestion: Add end padding or a fade/scroll affordance so chips aren’t abruptly truncated.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Use a single-line ellipsis or allow wrapping so names remain readable.

issues.description: The top-right circular control is empty except for a small red dot, so its purpose is unclear.
issues.suggestion: Add an icon (e.g. profile/notifications) and an accessible label for the badge.

issues.description: Heart/favorite buttons on restaurant cards have no visible text label.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible names (e.g. 'Save restaurant') so the controls are understandable to screen reader users.
